title: Media controller widget with "song name" uses more much horizontal space with no option to return to previous size
line: The Media Player widget has a new setting to show only the album art on a panel, without the title and artist.
explanation: Since Plasma 5.26 the Media Player widget on a panel always shows the song title and artist next to the album art, which takes up to about ten grid units of panel width. The only way back to a small button was to move it into the system tray, and the widget had no settings page at all (its Configure action was removed). The change adds a General settings page with a "Show title and artist when on a panel" checkbox (on by default); when it's off, the panel shows just the square album art.

commits.message:
applets/mediacontroller: add option to hide the title on panels

On a panel the widget always showed the title and artist next to the
album art, taking a lot of space, and there was no way to go back to a
compact button. Add a settings page with a checkbox to show only the art.

BUG: 459714

From 9967eb98f1086e0e7ac44b5220a364c5bef3c71d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 23:10:29 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/mediacontroller: add option to hide the title on
 panels

On a panel the widget always showed the title and artist next to the
album art, taking a lot of space, and there was no way to go back to a
compact button. Add a settings page with a checkbox to show only the art.

BUG: 459714

 applets/mediacontroller/CMakeLists.txt        |  4 ++++
 .../mediacontroller/CompactRepresentation.qml |  7 +++---
 applets/mediacontroller/ConfigGeneral.qml     | 22 +++++++++++++++++++
 applets/mediacontroller/config.qml            | 17 ++++++++++++++
 applets/mediacontroller/main.qml              |  4 ----
 applets/mediacontroller/main.xml              | 15 +++++++++++++
 6 files changed, 62 insertions(+), 7 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/mediacontroller/CMakeLists.txt b/applets/mediacontroller/CMakeLists.txt
index 0e03640bec..db0f60218e 100644
--- a/applets/mediacontroller/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/applets/mediacontroller/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -12,8 +12,12 @@ plasma_add_applet(org.kde.plasma.mediacontroller
         AlbumArtStackView.qml
         CompactRepresentation.qml
         ExpandedRepresentation.qml
+        config.qml
+        ConfigGeneral.qml
     CPP_SOURCES
         globalconfig.cpp
+    RESOURCES
+        main.xml
     GENERATE_APPLET_CLASS
     QML_ARGS ${QML_ARGS}
 )
diff --git a/applets/mediacontroller/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/mediacontroller/CompactRepresentation.qml
index e828b21696..0886e25cda 100644
--- a/applets/mediacontroller/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/mediacontroller/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -25,7 +25,7 @@ Loader {
     Layout.preferredWidth: {
         switch (compactRepresentation.layoutForm) {
         case CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.HorizontalPanel:
-            return implicitWidth + (root.track == "" ? 0 : Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing * 2);
+            return implicitWidth + (root.track == "" || !Plasmoid.configuration.showTitleInPanel ? 0 : Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing * 2);
         default:
             return -1;
         }
@@ -168,8 +168,9 @@ Loader {
 
             ColumnLayout {
                 Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignVCenter
-                visible: compactRepresentation.layoutForm !== CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.VerticalPanel && compactRepresentation.layoutForm !== CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.IconOnly
-                    || (compactRepresentation.layoutForm === CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.VerticalPanel && compactRepresentation.parent.width >= Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 5)
+                visible: (!compactRepresentation.inPanel || Plasmoid.configuration.showTitleInPanel)
+                    && (compactRepresentation.layoutForm !== CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.VerticalPanel && compactRepresentation.layoutForm !== CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.IconOnly
+                        || (compactRepresentation.layoutForm === CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.VerticalPanel && compactRepresentation.parent.width >= Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 5))
 
                 spacing: 0
 
diff --git a/applets/mediacontroller/ConfigGeneral.qml b/applets/mediacontroller/ConfigGeneral.qml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..00936b6cf0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/applets/mediacontroller/ConfigGeneral.qml
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
+
+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+import org.kde.kcmutils as KCM
+
+KCM.SimpleKCM {
+    property alias cfg_showTitleInPanel: showTitleInPanelCheckBox.checked
+
+    Kirigami.FormLayout {
+        QQC2.CheckBox {
+            id: showTitleInPanelCheckBox
+            text: i18nc("@option:check", "Show title and artist when on a panel")
+        }
+    }
+}
diff --git a/applets/mediacontroller/config.qml b/applets/mediacontroller/config.qml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..87d908beb3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/applets/mediacontroller/config.qml
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+import QtQuick
+
+import org.kde.plasma.configuration
+
+ConfigModel {
+    ConfigCategory {
+         name: i18n("General")
+         icon: "preferences-desktop-plasma"
+         source: "ConfigGeneral.qml"
+    }
+}
diff --git a/applets/mediacontroller/main.qml b/applets/mediacontroller/main.qml
index e1a34a8dd5..1b05379a1b 100644
--- a/applets/mediacontroller/main.qml
+++ b/applets/mediacontroller/main.qml
@@ -212,8 +212,4 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     Mpris.Mpris2Model {
         id: mpris2Model
     }
-
-    Component.onCompleted: {
-        Plasmoid.removeInternalAction("configure");
-    }
 }
diff --git a/applets/mediacontroller/main.xml b/applets/mediacontroller/main.xml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..f664085c1b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/applets/mediacontroller/main.xml
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
+<kcfg xmlns="http://www.kde.org/standards/kcfg/1.0"
+      xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
+      xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.kde.org/standards/kcfg/1.0
+      http://www.kde.org/standards/kcfg/1.0/kcfg.xsd" >
+  <kcfgfile name=""/>
+
+  <group name="General">
+    <entry name="showTitleInPanel" type="Bool">
+      <label>Whether to show the title and artist next to the album art when the widget is on a panel.</label>
+      <default>true</default>
+    </entry>
+  </group>
+
+</kcfg>
--

media.caption: Master: on a horizontal panel the widget always shows the title next to the art
With the option turned off, only the album art is shown on the panel
Master: the context menu has no Configure entry
The context menu now has Configure Media Player…
Vertical panel with the default setting: title and artist under the art (unchanged from master)
Vertical panel with the option off: only the art
